T0584.title: Edge Function
T0584.definition: Code executed at CDN or edge locations to transform requests, responses, authentication, or routing.
T0584.description: Edge functions execute logic at CDN or edge locations for authentication, rewriting, canarying, or content processing. Their permissions and blast radius can be large, so faulty code may affect significant traffic. Controls focus on code review, least privilege, versioned configuration, rollback capability, and edge logging.
T0584.usageExample: Assess Edge Function related exposure and define the corresponding controls.
